name: Khon Kaen International Marathon (22nd ed.)
short_description: The 22nd Khon Kaen International Marathon runs on 9 and 10 January 2027 at Khon Kaen University in Thailand, with the marathon, half marathon and 11.55 km mini marathon on Sunday 10 January.
ai_summary: The 22nd Khon Kaen International Marathon (KKIM 2027) is held on 9 and 10 January 2027 in Khon Kaen, Thailand, with the start and finish on Kanlapaphruek Road in front of the Golden Jubilee Convention Hall at Khon Kaen University. On Sunday 10 January the marathon (42.195 km) starts at 3am with a seven-hour limit, the half marathon at 4am and the 11.55 km mini marathon at 4.45am; the programme also includes a 5.4 km walk-run and a 2.8 km kids' run, which were held on the Saturday in 2026.

core_facts.venue: Kanlapaphruek Road, in front of the Golden Jubilee Convention Hall, Khon Kaen University
core_facts.organizer: Khon Kaen International Marathon Project, Khon Kaen University (Sports Division)

pros: Cool, dry January air: 16°C with an 11°C dew point at the 2026 marathon start
Seven-hour marathon limit with checkpoints at about 10 minutes per km
Water about every 2 km, with electrolyte and fruit at five points on the marathon
Free shuttles from the airport, stations and hotels, plus free tent areas
AIMS-certified course with prize money and a Top 100 award
cons: 3am marathon start, with hotel shuttle buses from 1.30am
Congested early kilometres in the shorter races, with walkers near the front
Saturday fun run was shortened at the last minute from 5.4 km to 4.8 km in 2026
No refunds, even if the race is postponed

faqs.question: When is the Khon Kaen International Marathon?
faqs.answer: Sunday 10 January 2027 for the marathon, half marathon and mini marathon; the organiser lists this 22nd edition, KKIM 2027, as a 9 and 10 January weekend. In 2026 the 5.4 km walk-run and 2.8 km kids' run were on the Saturday. The marathon starts at 3am and must be finished by 10am.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: Five: the marathon (42.195 km), the half marathon (21.1 km) and an 11.55 km mini marathon on Sunday, plus a 5.4 km walk-run and a 2.8 km kids' run. Cut-offs are seven hours for the marathon, three and a half hours for the half and two hours for the mini marathon.

faqs.question: Where does the race take place?
faqs.answer: At Khon Kaen University in north-east Thailand. The start and finish are on Kanlapaphruek Road in front of the Golden Jubilee Convention Hall. In 2026 the Sunday courses ran through the university and central Khon Kaen, while the shorter Saturday races stayed inside the campus.
